text: Canvas Quiz Converter
Canvas Quiz Converter
Turn a properly formatted plain-text quiz—and optional question images—into a Canvas-compatible QTI ZIP. No Python. No Command Prompt. No pretend code execution from a chatbot.
The defaults match the original converter.
Canvas quiz type
Create Canvas QTI ZIP
Errors block QTI creation. Warnings do not.
Upload the quiz text and images, then create the QTI ZIP.
In Canvas, use Settings → Import Course Content → QTI .zip File.

Upload an instructional image to the AI tool. Ask it to write one or more multiple-choice questions based on that image, produce concise alt text describing the information needed to answer the question, and append the questions to the existing quiz using the exact filename. Then upload the finished .txt file and the original images to this converter.
Version 1.1 • The downloaded ZIP should remain compressed when imported into Canvas.

Build a mixed-question Canvas quiz using only the exact plain-text format below. COURSE OR MODULE: [ENTER COURSE OR MODULE] LEARNING OBJECTIVES: [PASTE LEARNING OBJECTIVES] QUESTION DISTRIBUTION: [ENTER COUNTS, SUCH AS 4 Multiple Choice, 2 True/False, 2 Multiple Answers, 1 Fill in the Blank, and 1 Essay] QUIZ SETTINGS: Quiz Title: [ENTER TITLE] Quiz Description: [ENTER DESCRIPTION] Default Points: [ENTER POINT VALUE OR SPECIFY BY TYPE] REQUIRED RULES: 1. Return only the finished quiz text. Do not add an introduction, explanation, markdown fence, or closing note. 2. Begin with Quiz Title: and Quiz Description:. 3. Every question must begin with Title:, Type:, and Points:, followed by a sequentially numbered stem. 4. Use only these exact Type values: Multiple Choice, True/False, Multiple Answers, Fill in the Blank, or Essay. 5. Multiple Choice questions must contain four choices labeled A) through D) and exactly one starred correct answer. 6. True/False questions must use Answer: True or Answer: False. Do not add A) and B) choices. 7. Multiple Answers questions must contain four choices labeled A) through D), at least two starred correct answers, and at least one incorrect answer. 8. Fill in the Blank questions must contain one or more Accepted Answer: lines and a Case Sensitive: Yes or No line. 9. Essay questions must contain General Feedback: and must not contain answer choices or accepted answers. 10. Every auto-graded question must contain Correct Feedback: and Incorrect Feedback:. 11. Keep feedback accurate and instructional. Do not reveal the answer in the question stem. 12. Verify that every question assesses one of the supplied learning objectives and that exactly one question block exists for each requested question. 13. Use plain text. Preserve every label, colon, answer label, and asterisk exactly. FORMAT EXAMPLES: Title: Opportunity Cost Type: Multiple Choice Points: 10 1: Opportunity cost is best defined as: Correct Feedback: Correct. It is the value of the best alternative forgone. Incorrect Feedback: Focus on the best rejected alternative. *A) The value of the best alternative forgone B) The total money spent C) Every possible alternative D) A cost that cannot be recovered Title: Scarcity Type: True/False Points: 5 2: Scarcity exists because resources are limited relative to wants. Correct Feedback: Correct. Incorrect Feedback: Review the definition of scarcity. Answer: True Title: Demand Shifters Type: Multiple Answers Points: 10 3: Which factors can shift demand? Correct Feedback: Correct. Incorrect Feedback: Distinguish shifts from movements along a curve. *A) Consumer income *B) Consumer expectations C) The good's own current price *D) Number of buyers Title: Economic Term Type: Fill in the Blank Points: 5 4: The value of the best alternative forgone is called ______. Correct Feedback: Correct. Incorrect Feedback: Review the cost attached to the best rejected alternative. Accepted Answer: opportunity cost Accepted Answer: the opportunity cost Case Sensitive: No Title: Applied Analysis Type: Essay Points: 20 5: Explain how a binding price ceiling affects buyers and sellers. General Feedback: A strong answer addresses the lower legal price, shortage, rationing, and effects on market participants.

Canvas deployment
Composer-generated games are self-contained HTML files. Publish the game at a public HTTPS URL, then point Canvas directly at that URL. No second game wrapper file is required.
Point Canvas directly at the public game URL
Create or edit a Canvas page, switch to the HTML editor, and paste an iframe using your hosted URL.
pixels is a practical starting point. Increase it if your Canvas theme creates unnecessary internal scrolling.
If your institution blocks the iframe, use the same public HTTPS URL as an external Canvas link.

A downloaded local CSV stays on the student/faculty device unless deliberately shared. Submission through Canvas or another system transfers custody to that recipient/system. An admin export creates another copy outside the telemetry database. Server deletion cannot remove arbitrary downloads, submitted copies or backups.

If an instructor requires the file for an assignment, the student chooses to submit it through Canvas, email, another institutional system, or another course process specified by the instructor. Once submitted, that copy is governed by the policies, access controls, and retention practices of the receiving institution or service.
